title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
About: Lattivo builds performance and engagement software used by 900+ companies. We're a 220-person remote-first team growing engineering by 40% this year.

What you'll do:
- Own full-cycle recruiting for senior engineering and product roles, from intake to close
- Coach candidates through interview prep and offer decisions with honesty and care
- Partner with hiring managers to design structured, bias-resistant interview loops
- Build sourcing pipelines that don't rely on the same five job boards
- Report on funnel health and improve conversion at every stage

What we're looking for: 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting, at least 3 in technical recruiting at a startup or scaleup. You treat candidates like future colleagues, not inventory. Experience with Greenhouse, strong closing skills, and a genuine coaching instinct. Base salary $130,000-$155,000 plus equity and full benefits. This role is fully remote within the US.

title: Senior Talent Programs Manager
description:
About: Brightfern Labs is a 38-person edtech startup helping community colleges modernize career services. We practice what we sell: our internal talent programs are a product, and we want someone senior to own them.

What you'll do:
- Design and run onboarding, career pathing, and internal mobility programs from scratch
- Coach managers and ICs through career conversations and growth plans
- Build a lightweight performance framework that people don't dread
- Facilitate workshops on feedback, interviewing, and career development
- Partner with recruiting to make sure the candidate experience matches the employee experience

What we're looking for: 7+ years across recruiting, coaching, or people programs. You've built programs at a small company where there was no playbook. Formal coaching training or certification is a big plus. You write clearly and facilitate without slides when needed. Base salary $125,000-$150,000, meaningful early-stage equity, remote anywhere in the US with two optional team offsites a year.

title: Recruiting Lead, Go-to-Market
description:
About: Quellship makes logistics SaaS for mid-market shippers. We're 180 people, remote-first, and doubling our go-to-market org over the next 18 months.

What you'll do:
- Lead GTM recruiting: own senior sales and CS searches yourself while mentoring two recruiters
- Train hiring managers on structured interviewing and calibrated scorecards
- Build employer brand content that reflects how we actually work
- Own comp benchmarking for GTM roles with our finance partner
- Improve recruiting ops: pipeline hygiene, SLAs, and honest funnel metrics

What we're looking for: 7-10 years of recruiting with meaningful GTM hiring experience, ideally at a SaaS scaleup. You've mentored recruiters even if you haven't formally managed. You coach candidates as well as you assess them, and you can push back on a hiring manager with data and tact. Base salary $135,000-$160,000, equity, remote within the US.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
About: Nimbuswell Health runs virtual-first primary care clinics across eight states. We're 340 people and hiring both clinicians and corporate teams.

What you'll do:
- Manage a team of three recruiters covering clinical and corporate roles
- Carry a small personal req load for senior searches
- Set quarterly hiring plans with department leads and keep them honest
- Own candidate experience end to end, including a coaching-oriented offer process
- Report weekly on pipeline health and time-to-fill

What we're looking for: 6+ years recruiting, 1-2 managing or leading recruiters. Healthcare hiring experience is helpful but not required; caring about candidates is. Comfort with Lever and with imperfect data. Base salary $115,000-$135,000 depending on experience, plus bonus and equity. This is a hybrid role: two days a week in our Denver office, the rest remote.

title: Senior Recruiter, Product & Design
description:
About: Farrow & Slate is a 14-person boutique search firm working retained searches for venture-backed product companies. No contingency churn, no volume game: a handful of searches at a time, done well.

What you'll do:
- Run 3-4 retained searches concurrently for senior product and design roles
- Build market maps and write research-grade candidate briefs clients actually read
- Manage client relationships from intake through close
- Coach candidates through multi-stage processes at demanding companies
- Contribute to how a small firm builds its craft: templates, playbooks, calibration

What we're looking for: 6+ years recruiting with agency or executive search exposure. You write well, you're organized to a fault, and you'd rather do fewer searches better. Salaried base plus per-search bonus, not commission-dependent. Fully remote within the US; compensation discussed in the first conversation and calibrated to experience.

title: Lead Recruiter (Founding Talent Hire)
description:
About: Copperline Robotics builds warehouse automation for regional distributors. We're 32 people, Series A, and you'd be our first dedicated talent hire.

What you'll do:
- Own every search: mechanical engineers, embedded software, ops, and the occasional exec
- Stand up our recruiting stack (ATS, scheduling, scorecards) from nearly nothing
- Build a simple, honest employer brand for a company nobody has heard of yet
- Design offer bands with the founders and keep us consistent
- Lay the groundwork for onboarding so new hires don't flounder

What we're looking for: 5+ years recruiting, ideally with a zero-to-one build somewhere in your history. Hardware hiring experience is a plus, resourcefulness is a must. You'll wear people-ops hats sometimes. Base salary $110,000-$140,000 plus early equity. Hybrid: three days a week in our Austin shop, because half our roles require walking the floor.

title: Talent Development & Coaching Manager
description:
About: Verdana Systems provides compliance automation for regional banks. We're 260 people, fully remote, and investing in developing the managers we promoted too fast.

What you'll do:
- Deliver 1:1 career coaching to managers and high-potential ICs
- Design and facilitate our new-manager training series
- Run the 360 feedback cycle and coach people through their results
- Build lightweight learning content: guides, workshops, office hours
- Measure whether any of it works and kill what doesn't

What we're looking for: 4-7 years in talent development, coaching, or an adjacent people role. A coaching certification (ICF or similar) is strongly preferred. You facilitate with warmth and structure, and you're comfortable telling a director something they don't want to hear. Base salary $105,000-$125,000 plus bonus. Fully remote within the US with one annual company gathering.

title: Director of Talent Acquisition
description:
About: Pinemarten Software is a 900-person vertical SaaS company serving property managers. We're profitable, acquisitive, and rebuilding talent acquisition as a strategic function.

What you'll do:
- Lead a 12-person TA org across three hiring hubs
- Own annual workforce planning with finance and the exec team
- Run executive searches directly, including retained-firm management
- Integrate talent teams and processes from two recent acquisitions
- Present hiring health to the board quarterly

What we're looking for: 10+ years in recruiting with 4+ years managing managers. You've run TA at a 500+ person company, owned a real budget, and survived an integration or two. This is a second-line leadership role: strategy, org design, and executive stakeholder work far more than sourcing. Base salary $175,000-$210,000 plus bonus and equity. Hybrid, three days a week in our Seattle headquarters, with occasional travel to hub offices.

title: Recruiter
description:
About: Juniper Path Staffing places light-industrial and administrative workers with employers across the Phoenix metro. Our branch teams are fast, friendly, and busy.

What you'll do:
- Screen 20-30 candidates a day by phone and in person
- Post roles, mine job boards, and keep requisitions full
- Run background and reference checks and keep Bullhorn records current
- Coordinate start dates, timecards, and first-week check-ins
- Support senior recruiters on client intake calls

What we're looking for: 0-2 years of experience; retail, hospitality, or call-center backgrounds do great here. You're organized, quick on the phone, and unfazed by volume. Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus. Base salary $52,000-$62,000 plus quarterly branch bonuses. This position works out of our Phoenix branch office five days a week, since candidates walk in throughout the day.

title: Executive Recruiter (Commission)
description:
About: Kestrel Search Group is a distributed network of independent executive recruiters placing VP and C-level talent in industrial and manufacturing companies. We provide the brand, research support, and back office; you build your desk.

What you'll do:
- Develop your own client base through cold outreach and referrals
- Run contingency and engaged searches for senior leadership roles
- Negotiate fee agreements and own your client relationships end to end
- Source and close executives using our research team and tools
- Keep 100% of your pipeline decisions: no quotas, no territories

What we're looking for: 5+ years in agency recruiting or executive search with a track record of billings. Self-starters only. This role is 100% commission-based with no base salary; successful recruiters here earn $150,000-$400,000+ on a 60-70% payout split, but there is no draw and no guarantee. Fully remote. If you want a salary, this is not your desk.

title: Traveling Campus Recruiting Lead
description:
About: Halloran Field Services maintains utility infrastructure across 22 states and hires 300+ graduates a year into field engineering and operations rotations. Campus is how we grow, and campus means being on campuses.

What you'll do:
- Own recruiting relationships with 25 universities across the Midwest and South
- Run career fairs, info sessions, and on-campus interview days week after week
- Present to student chapters and build career-center relationships in person
- Manage offers and keep-warm programs through spring
- Train rotating employee ambassadors who join you on the road

What we're looking for: 5+ years in campus or high-volume recruiting and genuine comfort living on the road. Expect 100% travel during the academic year, August through April: you will be on a campus or traveling to one essentially every working day, with summers based from any Halloran regional office. Base salary $95,000-$115,000 plus full travel expenses and a vehicle allowance.

title: Talent Coordinator
description:
About: Marrow & Co. is a 45-person creative agency in SoHo producing brand campaigns for beauty and fashion clients. Our talent team keeps a bench of staff and freelance creatives flowing through the studio.

What you'll do:
- Schedule interviews and portfolio reviews across chaotic creative calendars
- Maintain our freelancer database and rate cards
- Host candidates in the studio and make them feel like guests, not applicants
- Post roles, sort inbound applications, and flag standouts
- Process freelancer invoices and support studio events

What we're looking for: 0-2 years in coordination, production, or agency support. You are unfailingly organized, warm in person, and calm when three things reschedule at once. This is a fully on-site position at our SoHo studio, five days a week, because the job is in the room: hosting, coordinating, and keeping the studio running. Base salary $58,000-$68,000 with overtime eligibility and summer Fridays.

title: Head of Talent
description:
About: Solstice Grid builds battery orchestration software for utility-scale solar. We're 46 people, Series B, and hiring our first Head of Talent to take us to 120.

What you'll do:
- Own all hiring: run senior searches yourself, then build a small team under you
- Define our compensation philosophy, leveling, and offer process
- Stand up people operations basics alongside our ops lead
- Work directly with founders and the board on org design and exec hiring
- Protect the culture while tripling the company

What we're looking for: 10+ years in talent, including leading recruiting at a venture-backed startup through a major growth phase. You've hired executives, built a team from zero, and have opinions about equity refreshes. This is a leadership role reporting to the CEO. Hybrid, with three days a week expected at our San Francisco office. Compensation includes significant equity; cash and equity details are shared in the first conversation.
